I need to implement a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, capped at a given positive limit. Once the cumulative sum reaches or exceeds the cap, all subsequent positions in the output array should remain fixed at that cap value.

I drafted two implementations. One uses a boolean flag to freeze the running total once it hits the cap. The simpler version uses `Math.min(total + num, cap)` on every step.
